title: Project Manager - Scrum Master
description:
Project Manager \- Scrum Master
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Project Manager will be responsible for managing projects following Agile methodologies. This role involves overseeing project deliverables, coordinating with cross functional teams, and ensuring the successful implementation of projects. The Project Manager will also act as a Scrum Master, facilitating Agile ceremonies and ensuring the team follows Agile practices and principles.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Lead and manage project teams in the successful execution of projects using agile methodologies.
  

2\. Act as a scrum master, facilitate agile ceremonies such as daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  

3\. Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  

4\. Monitor project progress, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
  

5\. Implement change management processes to address any scope changes or project deviations.
  

6\. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and agile best practices within the project team.
  

7\. Report project status, issues, and risks to stakeholders and senior management.


**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Proficient in agile methodologies and experienced in acting as a scrum master.
  

2\. Solid understanding of project management and change management principles.
  

3\. Strong leadership skills to motivate and guide project teams towards successful project delivery.
  

4\. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with stakeholders and team members effectively.
  

5\. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities in a fast paced environment.
  

6\. Problem\-solving skills to address project challenges and ensure project objectives are met.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\.Agile or Scrum Master certification is preferred.

title: Scrum Master, AVP
description:
Closing date for applications: 24/09/2026



Location Chennai, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


Flexible Schedule Available


This role is open to discussion on flexible scheduling such as part\-time, compressed hours, or job share options.


\#R\-00284847

  



**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Scrum Master

  

  

* We’re looking for an experienced Scrum Master to drive a culture of continuous improvement
* You’ll make sure that your team lives by the values of Scrum, empowering them to become high performing to increase the productivity, as well as frequency and quality of delivery
* Hone your project skills as you work with talented people in collaborative and innovative environment, with access to the bank's Agile community, experts and events
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

This role will see you coaching and guiding your team to perform at their highest level and at a sustainable pace. You’ll remove any impediments to progress, facilitate meetings, protect the team from outside influences or distractions and work with the product owner to make sure that the product backlog is in good shape and ready for the next sprint.

  

  

Your responsibilities will include:

  

  

* Making sure the Scrum team understands Agile practices, the Scrum framework and values, and that the team uses this framework to deliver working software to satisfy platform customers and react to their needs quickly
* Transforming the Scrum team to become self\-organising to reduce management overhead costs, using techniques such as Systems and Lean thinking
* Acting as the process owner for the team, and maintaining relationships with the project's key stakeholders
* Creating a great place to work with a culture of safety and continuous improvement, through great people leadership, coaching, engagement and development of skills
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  

  

We're looking for someone with experience of successful Scrum adoption along with a Scrum Master certification. You'll need knowledge of modern development practices and tools, as well as a background in coaching cross\-functional teams into high performing teams.

  

  

You’ll also need knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency, as well as experience of building a culture of transparency within feature teams by empowering individuals and inspiring a collaborative team performance.

  

  

We'll look to you to demonstrate:

  

  

* Experience working as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum, Agile frameworks, and SAFe practices.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex technology initiatives
* Experience of automated testing frameworks

**Welcome to our Chennai hub**
------------------------------


Nestled in the heart of One India Bulls Park, our hub in Kosmo One, Tower A, is one of Ambattur’s first skyscraper spanning 420,000 sq. ft.


### **Key facts:**


* Surrounded by 10 acres
* Space for 3,600 colleagues
* Opened in 2009

title: Team Coach 1
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Profile Summary**

**Job Summary:** The Team Coach \- Coaching \& Transformation for India supports the scaling and sustained adoption of BTOM\-aligned ways of working and promotes consistent, high\-quality coaching practices across assigned product teams and value streams

**Job Description:**

* Coach product teams on agile practices to drive delivery discipline and predictability. Provide 1:1 role\-based coaching for Product Owners and other team members to strengthen agile maturity.
* Apply coaching methodologies to support cross\-functional product teams in improving collaboration, enhancing delivery cadence, and achieving outcomes aligned with product goals.
* Facilitate team\-level ceremonies (e.g., planning, stand\-ups, retrospectives) to ensure effective collaboration, alignment, and dependency management.
* Coordinate with other teams to manage cross\-team dependencies and maintain alignment. Escalate blockers to senior coaches or leadership as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Support teams in improving performance through ongoing inspection of team practices and adoption of new approaches.
* Work with teams to define and develop objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities; assist in tracking progress through performance dashboards.
* Guide teams to leverage flow and outcome metrics effectively to inform improvement; support development of targeted coaching plans to enhance team performance and maturity.
* Contribute as a member of the Center of Excellence by adopting standards, sharing learnings, and supporting continuous evolution of the operating model.
* Partner with Product Owners to build and maintain a strong backlog aligned with product strategy and priorities.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to support team needs and maintain alignment with product goals.
* Reinforce team understanding of how their work contributes to product and value stream OKRs.

**Must have:**

* 7–9 years of experience in roles such as Scrum Master or Agile Coach, working with agile teams in a scaled environment.
* Good knowledge of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.) with experience in agile delivery practices and ability to reinforce strong team habits.
* Ability to coach teams using supportive and adaptive techniques to drive continuous improvement.
* Experience with agile tooling (e.g., Jira, SPM) and applying best practices for team\-level adoption.
* Exposure to OKR development and outcome\-based performance tracking.
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle and technology delivery.
* Familiarity with product platform constructs preferred.
* Working knowledge of engineering practices such as test automation, CI/CD, and DevOps.
* Good facilitation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to maintain alignment and transparency across teams and stakeholders.

**Good to have skills**:

* Developing enterprise mindset beyond team\-level execution
* Ownership and accountability for team\-level outcomes
* Inclination towards action, experimentation, and continuous improvement

**Location:**
-------------

This position can be based in any of the following locations:


Chennai, Gurgaon**Current Guardian Colleagues: Please apply through the internal Jobs Hub in Workday**
